question: List customers from France with their names.
sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' ORDER BY customer_id

question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: What is the revenue of each completed order?
sql: SELECT o.order_id, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id

question: Show the three buyers with highest spending in 2024, excluding refunded orders.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND o.status <> 'refunded' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 3

question: Show each category and its number of catalog products.
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.category_id

question: Find orders with no payments.
sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders AS o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments AS p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id) ORDER BY o.order_id

question: List suppliers with their product counts.
sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS products FROM suppliers AS s LEFT JOIN products AS p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name ORDER BY s.supplier_id

question: Which products cost more than the average catalog price?
sql: SELECT product_id, name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY product_id
